scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @matchanimal/web && npm run build -w @matchanimal/api
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @matchanimal/web && npm run lint -w @matchanimal/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck -w @matchanimal/web && npm run typecheck -w @matchanimal/api
scripts.cap:sync: pnpm run cap:build:web && pnpm exec cap sync
scripts.cap:run:android: pnpm run cap:sync && pnpm exec cap run android
scripts.cap:run:ios: pnpm run cap:sync && pnpm exec cap run ios
